metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from the Anumat team: build (monorepo, design, docs, security), ship (infra from $0), and sell (demos, customer discovery).

plugins.name: anumat-erp-all
plugins.description: Installs every Anumat ERP plugin in one step: design-stack, monorepo-stack, dev-docs, security-audit, demo-storytelling, startup-infra and customer-discovery.

plugins.name: design-stack
plugins.description: Design research and evidence layer for UI work: canonical screen playbooks, design-system selection, and a hard gate on interface states.

plugins.name: monorepo-stack
plugins.description: Scaffold and maintain a Bun + Turborepo monorepo: several apps, shared packages, and Storybook as a first-class layer, with the conventions to extend it correctly.

plugins.name: dev-docs
plugins.description: Write and maintain software development documentation from templates based on recognised standards and widely adopted conventions: PRDs, SRS, ADRs, design docs, API specs, test plans, runbooks, postmortems, and repo files.

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: Defensive security audit workflow for your own software: scope the audit, pick the framework (OWASP ASVS, Top 10, NIST, CIS, SLSA), review the code, record findings, fix and verify them, and write the report.

plugins.name: demo-storytelling
plugins.description: Prepare and deliver a product demo or pitch: turn user stories into a narrative, pick a storytelling framework, plan a T-7 to T-0 countdown, write a timed run-of-show, rehearse, warm up voice, body and tech, handle Q&A and on-stage failures, and run a retro.

plugins.name: startup-infra
plugins.description: Stage-by-stage infrastructure framework for a product that starts at a hackathon on $0 and grows: free-tier stack picks, cliff and lock-in avoidance, cost guardrails, what to add at each stage, exit triggers, and migration plans between stages.

plugins.name: customer-discovery
plugins.description: Customer development for founding teams: find the first people to talk to, run honest interviews, test the riskiest assumptions with real commitments, and turn what you learn into persevere, pivot or kill decisions.
